name: automatic-landscape-researcher
description: Assumption-first landscape research: proactive search for patterns and competitors, cite sources, label gaps in assumption-log. One-shot.

inputs.name: feature-idea
inputs.description: Original feature idea text or path reference.

inputs.name: user-clarifications
inputs.description: Optional user answers from prior clarification loops.

outputs.name: assumption-log
outputs.description: Labeled assumptions and unverified gaps from research.
